metaDescription: Order custom 23 oz wine glasses with your logo. Perfect for events and gifts. Browse our collection at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 23 oz wine glasses offer a generous capacity that suits both red and white wine lovers, making them a versatile choice for corporate events, trade shows, or employee gifts. Unlike standard 12 oz or 15 oz options, these larger glasses provide room for a full pour without frequent refills, which is ideal for receptions or tasting events. Many 23 oz styles feature stemless designs for durability and easy storage, and they can be decorated with screen printing or etching to display your brand prominently.
heroAltText: Custom 23 oz wine glasses with etched logo, stemless design, perfect for corporate events.
